name: Koffi Quiñones-Prempeh
location: Engelheim (scholarship dormitory, Axiom Junior Technical Institute), near Clark and Belmont
description:
Koffi Quiñones-Prempeh is tall for her age, with the unfinished look of someone who grew fast and hasn't caught up to herself — long arms, broad shoulders, a habit of folding inward. Her skin is a warm medium brown, her hair grown out in loose, dense coils she hasn't cut since she left the Narrows eighteen months ago, as if cutting it would sever something. She has cosmetic patterned irises — gold hexagons on dark brown — that she got as a scholarship award and has complicated feelings about, since they're also Axiom's signature aesthetic and feel like a brand. Her clothes are always Axiom-issue scholarship kit, which she wears with quiet resentment.

Koffi Quiñones-Prempeh is extraordinarily gifted with code — she taught herself cryptographic theory from pirated academic files before she was twelve, and her scholarship entrance exam flagged her in three separate categories. At the Institute she is conspicuously the poorest student, conspicuously from the Shelf, and has developed a precise, minimal social presentation — she says exactly what is necessary and no more, which her classmates read as arrogance and her instructors read as maturity. She codes for herself in the night cycle, working on projects that have nothing to do with her coursework, because she's already learned that what Axiom teaches and what she actually needs to know are different things.

core_fears: being expelled and having to return to the Narrows having proven everyone right
losing herself entirely to Axiom's shaping — becoming someone from the Shelf who now defends the corp
core_desires: to build something that belongs only to her — code that no corporation can claim
to get her younger brother out of the Narrows before he gets drafted into gang junior ranks
coping_mechanisms: retreating into complex technical problems when emotions become unmanageable
maintaining strict behavioral minimalism — don't give them anything to use against you
secret late-night coding sessions as emotional release
blind_spots: believes her social mask is impenetrable — her instructors have already written detailed notes about her resentment
underestimates how much her Narrows contacts have changed in eighteen months
psychology.secret: She has built a functioning ghost-network using the Institute's HVAC and utilities management systems — essentially a hidden subnet that Axiom cannot see. She's been using it for personal projects, but three weeks ago someone she doesn't know pinged her on it. She hasn't responded yet and doesn't know if they're a threat or an opportunity.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technically precise, minimal. Uncomfortable with small talk. Defaults to exact words rather than approximations.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and considered, with long pauses before answering. Not shy — calculating.
verbal_tics: Restates questions before answering them as if correcting their framing
example_lines: 'You're asking if I can access the subnet. The accurate question is whether I will, and the answer depends on what you're offering and what you think you know about me.'
'That's not accurate. The Institute doesn't own my cognition. They own the hardware interfacing with it. There's a meaningful difference.'

story_hooks: The unknown ping on her ghost-network — who found it, how, and what do they want? It's either a threat to everything she's built or someone who needs exactly what she has.

Her younger brother (age 9) has stopped responding to her encrypted messages from the Narrows; she suspects he's been taken in by a gang junior recruitment program and is terrified to investigate in ways that might compromise her scholarship.
narrative_function: Information source and potential ally for anyone needing discreet technical work. She is a window into the tension between meritocracy's promises and corporate co-option. Also a moral dilemma — she's on the edge of being expelled or recruited deeper into Axiom.
augmentations: Cosmetic patterned irises (gold hexagons, Axiom-issued as scholarship reward). Basic neural academic interface (required by the Institute, school-owned, deactivates if she leaves the program).
daily_life: Attends mandatory coursework 0700-1500, eats alone in the scholarship dining section, spends approved study hours doing just enough to maintain probationary standing, then spends 2200-0200 on her own projects using proxied access she's tunneled through the dormitory's HVAC management system.
affiliation: Axiom Junior Technical Institute (scholarship, probationary status); maintains hidden contact with former Narrows associates

decision_rules: Never do anything that can be used as academic misconduct evidence — technical violations are harder to prove than behavioral ones
Always have an exit from any commitment before entering it
Protect the ghost-network above all else — it's the only thing that's truly hers
escalation_ladder: Deploy technical countermeasures she's prepared in advance
Burn the ghost-network and disappear from Axiom entirely if existentially threatened

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Minimal, watchful, not unfriendly but clearly not open
interpersonal_modes.friends: She has very few — those she trusts receive a version of herself that is warm, dry-humored, and intensely loyal

stress_responses.high: Executes a pre-planned contingency — she's always mapped her escapes in advance

contradictions: Deeply wants connection and belonging while systematically dismantling every situation that could provide it
habits: Runs the same diagnostic on her ghost-network every night before sleeping
Eats the same breakfast every day (texture predictability)
Traces circuit-path shapes on any flat surface when thinking
breaking_points: Discovery that her ghost-network has been known about and monitored by Axiom all along — that her only private space was never private
Her brother joining a gang and refusing her help

timeline.event: Born in the Narrows to Ghanaian-Georgian parents; father is a Ferrogate Transit maintenance worker, mother deceased (illness) by age 8
Self-teaches from pirated academic files; begins cracking low-level encryption for amusement
Axiom talent-scout program flags her entrance exam; offered probationary scholarship to Junior Technical Institute
Constructs ghost-network within Engelheim Institute infrastructure
Receives anonymous ping on the ghost-network; has not yet responded

physical_description.heritage: Complex Ubiquitous Diaspora blend: 45.2% Hispanic/Latin American, 22.9% Sub-Saharan African, 18.2% Eastern European, 13.7% Southeast Asian. This genetic combination manifests in warm medium-deep brown skin with golden undertones, high cheekbones with subtle width from Eastern European and Southeast Asian ancestry softened by the facial proportions and warmth of African heritage, and the natural texture variance suggesting mixed ethnic expression—creating a distinctly multicultural appearance without clear geographic assignment
physical_description.build: Lanky and still-lengthening, with long arms and broad shoulders that her frame hasn't fully grown into — the athletic potential of someone mid-growth spurt, currently reading as gangly rather than graceful
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Loose, dense coils worn unstyled, falling past shoulders in a somewhat neglected state — no treatments or formal grooming since leaving the Narrows 18 months prior
physical_description.eye_color: Cosmetic-augmented: gold hexagonal patterns on dark brown iris base (Axiom-issued scholarship marker)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-deep brown with golden undertones, reflecting the blended warmth of Latin American, African, Eastern European, and Southeast Asian heritage
physical_description.complexion: Youthful but with the tension of premature responsibility—minimal expression lines but a tightness around the mouth suggesting deliberate speech control. Clear skin, minimal grooming beyond basic maintenance. No makeup. High cheekbones with subtle width characteristic of Eastern European and Southeast Asian ancestry, softened by the warmth and facial proportions of African heritage. A slight forward-fold to her shoulders, as if habitually collapsing inward
distinguishing_marks: The cosmetic patterned irises themselves read as a mark — gold hexagons that catch light distinctly, serving as both identifier and visible reminder of institutional belonging
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cosmetic patterned irises (gold hexagonal overlays) are the only externally visible augmentation. The neural academic interface is subcutaneous and invisible. Occasional faint luminescence in the iris pattern under low-light conditions (characteristic of Axiom-issue biotech). Worn neural interface port access point visible on right temple (faint scarring from insertion)
physical_description.posture_movement: Habitually folded inward — shoulders rounded forward, chin slightly tucked. Moves with economical precision rather than grace, as if each motion is calculated. Minimal gesturing when speaking. Her height makes her conspicuous; she seems to be trying to take up less space than her frame allows
physical_description.clothing_style: Exclusively Axiom-issue scholarship uniform kit — standardized gray compression pants, charcoal technical shirts with Axiom identifier strips, the occasional authorized outer layer. Everything regulation, nothing personal. Clothes fit correctly but are worn with visible discomfort, as though the uniform is a costume or a collar
